impact: Signals YMTC's technical rise and closer Korea-China NAND ties at a time of US export curbs; a watch item for NAND competition and for MU's NAND pricing.
summary: Nikkei Asia reported Thursday that Samsung and SK Hynix agreed to adopt parts of Chinese chipmaker YMTC's 3D NAND stacking technology through cross-licensing. Samsung declined to comment.
title: Samsung, SK Hynix to adopt China YMTC's NAND stacking tech, Nikkei says
